+"""Base Metric dataclass shared across all metrics_v2 metrics."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Metric:
+    """A named numeric metric with a unit label.
+
+    Attributes
+    ----------
+    name : str
+        Metric identifier (e.g. 'cycle_time', 'wait_time').
+    value : float
+        Numeric measurement.
+    unit : str
+        Unit label (e.g. 'seconds').
+    """
+
+    name: str
+    value: float
+    unit: str

+"""Cycle-time metric — duration from start to finish.
+
+Returns end - start as a Metric with unit='seconds'.
+Returns None if end < start (invalid input policy).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from orgos.agile.metrics_v2.base import Metric
+
+
+def cycle_time(start_ts: float, end_ts: float) -> Metric | None:
+    """Compute cycle time as end_ts - start_ts.
+
+    Parameters
+    ----------
+    start_ts : float
+        Start timestamp (epoch seconds or any monotonic clock).
+    end_ts : float
+        End timestamp.
+
+    Returns
+    -------
+    Metric | None
+        A Metric with name='cycle_time', value=end_ts-start_ts, unit='seconds',
+        or None if end_ts < start_ts.
+    """
+    if end_ts < start_ts:
+        return None
+    return Metric(name="cycle_time", value=end_ts - start_ts, unit="seconds")

+"""Wait-time metric — duration from ready to start.
+
+Returns start - ready as a Metric with unit='seconds'.
+Returns None if start < ready (invalid input policy).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from orgos.agile.metrics_v2.base import Metric
+
+
+def wait_time(ready_ts: float, start_ts: float) -> Metric | None:
+    """Compute wait time as start_ts - ready_ts.
+
+    Parameters
+    ----------
+    ready_ts : float
+        Timestamp when the item became ready.
+    start_ts : float
+        Timestamp when the item started.
+
+    Returns
+    -------
+    Metric | None
+        A Metric with name='wait_time', value=start_ts-ready_ts, unit='seconds',
+        or None if start_ts < ready_ts.
+    """
+    if start_ts < ready_ts:
+        return None
+    return Metric(name="wait_time", value=start_ts - ready_ts, unit="seconds")

+"""Tests for wait_time metric."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from orgos.agile.metrics_v2.cycle_time import cycle_time
+from orgos.agile.metrics_v2.wait_time import wait_time
+
+
+class TestWaitTime:
+    """Test suite for wait_time function."""
+
+    def test_positive_wait(self) -> None:
+        """wait_time(10.0, 30.0) returns Metric with value == 20.0."""
+        result = wait_time(10.0, 30.0)
+        assert result is not None
+        assert result.value == 20.0
+
+    def test_name(self) -> None:
+        """.name == 'wait_time'."""
+        result = wait_time(10.0, 30.0)
+        assert result is not None
+        assert result.name == "wait_time"
+
+    def test_unit_matches_cycle_time(self) -> None:
+        """.unit matches .unit from cycle_time."""
+        w = wait_time(10.0, 30.0)
+        c = cycle_time(10.0, 30.0)
+        assert w is not None
+        assert c is not None
+        assert w.unit == c.unit
